rationale: RRC surged ~17.66% yesterday on an acquisition announcement (exchange ratio deal with EQT), meaning the stock is now trading as a merger arbitrage instrument rather than on its own technicals — the price is anchored to EQT's share price times 0.987, not to any momentum or mean-reversion setup. The last five 1-minute candles show a slow, low-volume drift downward from $54.53 to $54.42 with no clear directional catalyst, and the price is already 76.7% through today's range with the 9-EMA just above at $54.47 acting as mild resistance. In a merger-arb regime, intraday edge is minimal without knowing EQT's real-time price and deal spread dynamics, making this a poor risk/reward setup for a directional intraday trade.
